name: Steel Round Bars
verdict: Google Business Profile is the only active channel driving results, with 398 total actions (284 directions, 17 calls, 97 web clicks) over 28 days, but momentum is fading fast with GBP actions down 30.1% week-over-week, likely due to seasonal slowdown or reduced profile engagement. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and zero leads, meaning there is no paid pipeline to offset the organic decline.

performance.verdict: Paid channels are dead; organic is now fading too — no safety net.

findings.text: Zero paid spend and zero leads for all 28 days in window. No Meta, no Google Ads — this account is generating no paid pipeline whatsoever.
GBP actions last 2 days are 0 and 0 (Jul 27–28), vs a 28-day average of ~14.6/day — the sharpest drop in the series, not just seasonal drift.
Search clicks (sc) also collapsed: last 3 days averaged 2.7 clicks/day vs prior 3-day avg of 20.3 — a 87% drop, confirming organic demand erosion, not just GBP.
GBP is down 24% week-on-week across 410 total actions, with directions (290) dominant — suggesting intent exists locally but call volume (17) is critically thin.
GA4 sessions are zero for all 28 days — either tracking is broken or the property is disconnected, making web conversion data completely invisible.

suggestions.text: Verify GA4 property connection immediately — 28 days of zero sessions signals a broken or unmapped property, not zero traffic.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions have read zero for all 28 days in the series — this is almost certainly a disconnected or misconfigured property, not real zero traffic. Audit the GA4 data stream and confirm the measurement ID matches the live site. Success check: at least one non-zero session day within 3 days of the fix. Deadline: 2026-08-01.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP and sc_clicks through Aug 1 — last 2 days at zero may be a reporting lag, not a true signal. Do not act until 3-day pattern confirms.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on Jul 27 and Jul 28, and sc_clicks averaged 2.7/day over the last 3 days vs 20.3 the prior 3 days — an 87% drop. This may be a weekend/reporting lag given the series shows prior weekend dips (e.g. Jul 4: 0 clicks, Jul 5: 5). Re-check on 2026-08-01: if the 3-day average remains below 8 clicks/day, escalate to a GBP profile audit and consider reactivating paid search to protect local intent capture.

suggestions.text: Escalate paid reactivation decision to Sohib — account has zero paid activity for 28+ days with no pipeline fallback. CPL baseline cannot be defended at zero spend.
suggestions.monday_update: Steel Round Bars has recorded zero Meta and zero Google Ads spend for the entire 28-day window, generating zero leads. GBP is producing 410 actions but call volume is only 17 and declining. There is no paid safety net if organic continues to drop. Sohib to confirm: is the account intentionally paused (budget hold, seasonal pause), or is this a lapsed campaign that needs reactivation? Decision needed by 2026-08-01 to avoid further pipeline drought.
